== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Field Dressing (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-03-Field_Dressing.png]]) shows PC-E2 (“its forfeit”); the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-fielddressing-pre.gif]]) shows PC-E3.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee news post "Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes" (23 July 2010, effective 26 July 2010: https://web.archive.org/web/20100820023348/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=255:pre-worlds-2010-errata-changes&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50) and the PC website card list (VBlock7Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If you just forfeited a character of ability < 5 present at a site, deploy on that character (who remains at same site and, if 'hit,' is restored to normal). Character is forfeit = 0 (even if forfeit may not normally be reduced). May play First Aid to place this card in Used Pile. Immune to your Control.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1271_38</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
